name: Recover
body:
Design creation (healing); Level 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You create a small amount of vital force to heal a creature, healing it for 1d6 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +5). This script has no effect on an undead creature or construct.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, it heals an additional 1d6 points of damage.
